title: A landing whose own ticket another landing removed counts every later ticket as ahead and is starved behind later askers until its wait bound
goal: landing_tickets_ahead lists no ticket once the ticket of the asking landing is missing from the queue, and the landing takes its place in the queue again

run:
import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_close
t = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", t], check=True)
qdir = bl_close.landing_queue_dir(bl_close.landing_lock_path(t))
qdir.mkdir()
child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(60)"])
try:
    time.sleep(1)
    now = time.time_ns()
    later = "%020d-%d" % (now + 5 * 10 ** 9, child.pid)
    (qdir / later).write_text("pid=%d\nclone=%s\nstarted=x\nitem=ST-bbbbbbbb\n" % (child.pid, t))
    mine = "%020d-%d" % (now, os.getpid())
    ahead = [a[0] for a in bl_close.landing_tickets_ahead(qdir, mine)]
    print("tickets this landing waits for, all asked after it:", ahead)
    sys.exit(0 if not ahead else 1)
finally:
    child.kill()
